title: Interest account update succeeded [Beta]
description: This event occurs when an interest account configuration is successfully updated with product interest engine.

external_account_id.title: External account ID
external_account_id.description: Client-provided external account ID used for external system integration

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.description: Market index used to measure the interest a value will have over time

fixed_interest_rate.title: Fixed interest rate
fixed_interest_rate.description: Unchanging rate to be paid over the investments or deposits made. This means that from the moment the clients invest or deposit their money, they know exactly how much they will receive after the maturity date.

margin_rate.title: Margin rate
margin_rate.description: Rate linked to your benchmark rate (for example: 103% DI, 100% BOE, 90% RBI/RBA). Margin rates are in bold.

margin.title: Margin
margin.description: Also known as spread, this is an incremental rate the clients receive over the investments or deposits made.

capitalization_frequency.title: Capitalization frequency
capitalization_frequency.description: This determines when the clients will have their interest paid. It can be daily, monthly, quarterly, half yearly, yearly or at maturity.

taxes_exemption.title: Taxes exemption
taxes_exemption.description: Indicates if the account is exempt from taxes

fee_processing_code.title: Fee processing code
fee_processing_code.description: Processing code configured in the fee model in order to charge a tax, penalty or fee

updated_at.title: Updated at
updated_at.description: Timestamp when the interest account configuration was successfully updated

effective_date.title: Effective date
effective_date.description: First date the configuration change applies. Populated for configuration changes made through PATCH. Format = YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.title: End date
end_date.description: Last date (inclusive) the configuration change applies. Present only when supplied in the request. Format = YYYY-MM-DD.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Client-provided metadata object, up to 4096 serialized UTF-8 bytes. Empty object when omitted in the PATCH request.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Individual tier configuration for tiered interest calculation

days.title: Days
days.description: Number of days for this tier

fixed_interest_rate.title: Fixed interest rate
fixed_interest_rate.description: Fixed interest rate for this tier

fixed_percentage.title: Fixed percentage
fixed_percentage.description: Fixed percentage rate for this tax rule

threshold_amount.title: Threshold amount
threshold_amount.description: Amount threshold above which this tax rule applies
